titre: Fret aérien mondial : la demande devance la capacité
sous_titre: Variation sur un an, en pourcentage, avril à juillet 2026

Avril 2026.texte: Total demand, measured in cargo tonne-kilometers (CTK), increased by 4.0% compared to April 2025 levels

Mai 2026.texte: Total demand, measured in cargo tonne-kilometers (CTK), increased by 6.0% compared to May 2025 levels

Juin 2026.texte: Total demand, measured in cargo tonne-kilometers (CTK), increased by 8.5% compared to June 2025

Juillet 2026.texte: Total demand, measured in cargo tonne-kilometers (CTK), increased by 3.9% compared to July 2025
